item.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Houston merchandise now on sale
item.description: The merch has the “26 Houston” graphics on t-shirts and hoodies for adults and children, hats, pins, magnets and a water bottle.

item.title: Eight skiers killed in California avalanche, one missing
item.description: Eight skiers who were caught in an avalanche Tuesday near Lake Tahoe have been found dead, according to the Nevada County Sheriff’s Office. One person is still missing, and six others were rescued.

item.title: Trial against alleged 'Antifa cell' tied to shooting at Texas ICE detention facility set to begin
item.description: The trial against nine people arrested in connection to a shooting at an Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facility south of Fort Worth in July 2025 is expected to start next week. The trial had been scheduled to start this week, but on Tuesday, the judge in the case declared a mistrial.

item.title: Very warm with morning fog through Friday, low rain chances this week
item.description: Dry skies will start early in the morning and continue all day.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly asking child for a ride in Katy, constable says
item.description: Fort Bend County authorities arrested a man they believed attempted to lure a child into his vehicle while walking to the school bus in a Katy neighborhood.

item.title: Unruly passenger forces Delta flight back to Houston, airline says no cockpit threat
item.description: Delta Air Lines flight grounded at Houston airport after disturbance. Cockpit breach attempt, details unclear. Police investigating.

item.title: Ramadan 2026: What is it and when does it start?
item.description: Ramadan, the holiest month in Islam, begins at sunset on Feb. 17. The month of fasting, prayer and reflection follows the lunar calendar and ends with the celebration of Eid al-Fitr. Here’s what to know about when it starts and why Muslims observe it.

item.title: Rep. Tony Gonzales attacks primary opponent amid reporting of his affair with aide who died by suicide
item.description: Rep. Tony Gonzales declined to answer questions about the alleged affair, but he has previously dismissed the allegations as untrue.

item.title: Off-duty Harris County deputy killed in motorcycle crash in North Harris County
item.description: A Harris County deputy was killed in an off-duty traffic crash early Wednesday morning at the intersection of Aldine Westfield Road and Ciderwood Drive in north Harris County.

item.title: HPD arrests suspect in deadly game room shooting in southwest Houston
item.description: Police are searching for a person of interest in the investigation of the shooting death of a security guard in southwest Houston earlier this month.
